text:
maria_sales: Quick sync 40k wants to run a POC. Primary asks: model onboarding checklist, rough latency target 150ms p95, and estimated cost for ~100k tokens/day.

sam: Checklist: model artifact (HF or container), max seq, avg prompt, expected concurrency, any custom ops.

maria_sales: They sent HF repo link and say avg prompt 60, max 2048, concurrency 20.

leo_eng: Compat notes: check tokenizer mapping, kv-cache for chat, and quantization path. If only fp16 provided, run quantization safety pass.

anya_sec: Security asks: completed questionnaire, SSO (SAML) needs, and whether customer-managed KMS required. Also ask for data flow diagram.

oliver_ops: Sizing: for 20 concurrency @2048 -> 2-3 A10G-equivalents unquantized, 1-2 if q4. Hosted POC ok for initial test. Estimate Hosted cost $6k-$10k/mo for 100k tokens/day; Dedicated lower unit cost but commitment needed.

maria_sales: Can engineering provide a tiny probe script we can hand them?

leo_eng: I'll post a minimal probe they can run and the expected JSON keys: tokenization_ok, kv_ok, suggested_quant, supports_streaming.

anya_sec: I'll upload the QA template and prefill answers. Link in DM. Ask customer to return in 48h.

maria_sales: Great. I'll draft the POC scope with both Hosted and Dedicated pricing options and flag HSM/on-prem if they require it. Thanks all :thumbsup:
